name: Beetroot Nitrate
summary: Beetroot nitrate (dietary nitrate) drives nitric-oxide-mediated exercise and vascular effects. A 2024 crossover (n=44) found beetroot extract improved memory consolidation (+20.7% intermediate, +12.3% delayed recall); a 2024 trial in hypertensive postmenopausal women cut post-exercise systolic BP by 9.3 mmHg. Cognitive effects are new and need replication.
description: Canonical beetroot nitrate research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until nitrate dose standardization, beetroot vs isolated-nitrate boundaries, and replication status of the cognition signal have passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: nitrate-nitrite-nitric oxide pathway; vascular function; exercise performance
